title: ItemList - Shift+Up/Down selection doesn't work when max columns is set to 0 (auto)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e], v4.7.dev5.official [a8643700c], v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9597) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12450H (12 threads) - 31.71 GiB memory

### Issue description

When an ItemList has Max Columns set to 0 (automatic column count) and Select Mode set to Multi, pressing Shift+Up or Shift+Down does not extend the selection. The selected item stays the same - selection does not grow to include items in the row above or below.
Expected behavior: The selection extends to include items in the row above/below, the same way regular Up/Down moves the cursor between rows.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add an ItemList to a scene
2. Set Max Columns to 0, Select Mode to Multi, Fixed Column Width to ~100
3. Add ~10 items so they display in a grid with multiple rows
4. Run the scene, click on any item in the middle of the list
5. Press Shift+Up or Shift+Down

N/A
